headline: Mobilizing Capital, Strengthening Bank Resilience – Part 2: Deposits Rise, Asset Quality Under Pressure
summary: Individual deposits in Vietnam's banking system exceeded 11 quadrillion dong while credit kept expanding. Bad debt and debt requiring attention rose faster than outstanding loans.
why: Asset quality trends at banks determine provisioning costs, earnings and the capacity to support lending growth.
